description: Event catalogue for the Card Transaction Authorisation journey. Introduces 5 new events: EVT-064 through EVT-068. All events use card_number_token as the card identifier — raw PAN is NEVER included in any event payload. PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5.1 compliance is maintained by design. Events are routed via SVC-102 (event bus). Financial and PII-tagged events are also written to the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111) for PCI DSS v4.0 Req 10.7 and FCA BCOBS 7-year retention.
pci_dss_reminder: No event payload in this catalogue contains a raw PAN. card_number_token is the sole card identifier in all payloads. Any consumer who receives these events remains out of PCI DSS CDE scope provided they do not attempt to reverse-tokenise card_number_token.
catalogue_principles: All event names are in past tense (domain event naming convention)
Payload schemas carry the minimum data required for consumers to act
Raw PAN is NEVER included in any payload — card_number_token only
decline_reason is NEVER included in EVT-066 (CardAuthorisationDeclined) payload to consumers outside SVC-011 — the scheme_response_code is the external-facing decline indicator

events.name: CardAuthorisationRequested
events.trigger: SVC-011 has received an ISO 8583 / ISO 20022 authorisation request from the card network (PER-009) in PH-041. The raw PAN has been tokenised to card_number_token. A CardAuthorisation entity (ENT-032) has been created with status = pending_decision. Published immediately on request receipt — before the authorisation decision is made — to establish the immutable audit record entry.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published and primarily consumed within CAP-003 (SVC-011 and audit infrastructure). The audit record must be created before the decision to ensure tamper-evident evidence even if SVC-011 crashes during decision processing.

payload_schema.auth_id: string (UUID v4) — CardAuthorisation identifier, correlation key for all subsequent authorisation events
payload_schema.card_number_token: string — format-preserving token. NEVER the raw PAN.
payload_schema.customer_id: string (UUID v4) — resolved from card_number_token via SVC-011 authorisation cache
payload_schema.account_id: string (UUID v4) — FK to ENT-004 (debit) or ENT-023 (credit)
payload_schema.amount: string (decimal as string, e.g. '42.50') — transaction amount in transaction currency
payload_schema.transaction_type: string enum (card_present | card_not_present | contactless | atm_withdrawal | recurring)
payload_schema.channel_country_code: string — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, country of merchant/ATM
payload_schema.three_ds_result: string enum (authenticated | attempted | not_authenticated | not_required | not_applicable) — null for card_present

events.pci_compliance_note: card_number_token is the sole card identifier. Consumers of this event do NOT enter PCI CDE scope by receiving this event, provided they do not attempt to de-tokenise card_number_token.

consumers.action: Creates immutable audit log entry. PCI DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1 — log all access to cardholder data. WORM pipeline write.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-card strict ordering via card_number_token partition key on topic card.authorisations. All events for a given card_number_token are sequenced within the same partition.
events.worm_rationale: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1 — audit log of cardholder data environment access events. Required for Visa/Mastercard dispute resolution evidence (up to 120 days chargeback window). FCA BCOBS 7-year account records retention.

events.name: CardAuthorisationCompleted
events.trigger: SVC-011 has made an approved authorisation decision in PH-042. CardAuthorisation.status has been updated to approved. Authorisation code generated. Authorisation response sent to card network. Published after the response is transmitted to ensure the event record is consistent with what the card network received.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-011); consumed by CAP-004 (SVC-013 — fraud pattern learning) and CAP-001 (SVC-001 debit balance reservation; SVC-003 credit balance reservation). Key cross-capability event for this journey.

payload_schema.card_number_token: string — format-preserving token. NEVER the raw PAN.
payload_schema.billing_amount_gbp: string (decimal as string) — GBP equivalent for foreign currency transactions; equal to amount if currency = GBP
payload_schema.transaction_type: string enum (card_present | card_not_present | contactless | atm_withdrawal | recurring)
payload_schema.sca_exemption_applied: string enum (low_value_contactless | recurring_transaction | transaction_risk_analysis | merchant_initiated | null)
payload_schema.processing_time_ms: integer — milliseconds from request to response

events.pci_compliance_note: card_number_token is the sole card identifier. No raw PAN. Consumers of this event do NOT enter PCI CDE scope.

consumers.action: Asynchronous fraud pattern learning: updates real-time transaction velocity counters for card_number_token, enriches cardholder behaviour model with merchant_category_code, amount, channel_country_code, and transaction_type. Evaluates post-auth fraud patterns across recent transactions. If suspicious pattern detected (e.g. geographic impossibility across recent auths), publishes SuspiciousCardActivityDetected (EVT-068). This consumption is for model learning and post-auth pattern detection ONLY — it does NOT affect the already-issued authorisation decision.

Debit card balance reservation: if card_type = debit, SVC-001 consumes EVT-065 and decrements Account.available_balance by billing_amount_gbp. Creates a pending reservation record. Idempotent on auth_id. Balance reservation released and replaced by final ledger debit on receipt of CardSettlementProcessed (EVT-067).

Credit card balance reservation: if card_type = credit, SVC-003 consumes EVT-065 and decrements CreditCardAccount.available_balance by billing_amount_gbp. Idempotent on auth_id. Balance reservation released and replaced by final ledger debit on receipt of CardSettlementProcessed (EVT-067).
Immutable WORM audit record. PCI DSS Req 10.2. Records auth_code, processing_time_ms, sca_exemption_applied for compliance evidence.

events.consumer_routing_note: SVC-001 and SVC-003 are both subscribed to this topic. Each consumer filters on card_type: SVC-001 processes card_type = debit; SVC-003 processes card_type = credit. Implementations must ensure idempotent processing on auth_id to handle at-least-once delivery.
events.ordering_guarantees: Per-card strict ordering via card_number_token partition key on topic card.authorisations.
events.worm_rationale: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 10.2. Primary audit evidence for Visa/Mastercard chargeback dispute resolution (120-day window). FCA BCOBS account records. auth_code and authorised_at are key dispute fields.

events.name: CardAuthorisationDeclined
events.trigger: SVC-011 has made a declined authorisation decision in PH-042. CardAuthorisation.status = declined. Decline response (scheme_response_code) sent to card network. Published after the response is transmitted.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-011); consumed by CAP-004 (SVC-013 — velocity counter updates and fraud rule evaluation). CAP-001 does NOT consume this event — no balance reservation is created for declined transactions.

payload_schema.card_number_token: string — format-preserving token. NEVER the raw PAN.
payload_schema.scheme_response_code: string — ISO 8583 action code (e.g. '51', '05', '41'). This is the EXTERNAL-FACING decline code. NOT the internal decline_reason.
payload_schema.transaction_type: string enum (card_present | card_not_present | contactless | atm_withdrawal | recurring)

events.payload_omissions: decline_reason (the internal enum: insufficient_funds | fraud_rule_triggered | etc.) is deliberately EXCLUDED from this event payload. Specific internal decline reasons must not be distributed beyond SVC-011 and the WORM audit pipeline to prevent card testing attacks. The scheme_response_code (e.g. '51') is the only decline indicator in the payload.
events.pci_compliance_note: card_number_token is the sole card identifier. No raw PAN. Consumers do NOT enter PCI CDE scope.

consumers.action: Processes declined authorisations for fraud velocity analysis: updates decline rate counters for card_number_token. High decline rates (particularly on card_not_present transactions) are a signal of card testing attacks. SVC-013 may publish SuspiciousCardActivityDetected (EVT-068) if the pattern indicates a card testing attack or compromised card.
WORM audit record including decline_reason (from ENT-032, accessed directly by SVC-103 within SVC-011's audit pipeline, NOT via event payload). PCI DSS Req 10.2. Visa/Mastercard dispute evidence.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-card strict ordering via card_number_token partition key on topic card.authorisations.
events.worm_rationale: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 10.2. Decline records are required evidence for dispute resolution and fraud investigation. Internal decline_reason is logged to WORM pipeline via SVC-103 direct ENT-032 access — not via this event payload.

events.name: CardSettlementProcessed
events.trigger: SVC-011 has processed the end-of-day clearing file from the card scheme (PH-045), matched the clearing item to the pre-authorised CardAuthorisation (ENT-032) by auth_id, and created a CardSettlement entity (ENT-033) with the final settled amount, interchange_fee, and scheme_fee.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-011); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001 debit ledger posting; SVC-003 credit ledger posting). Triggers the final account ledger debit and release of the balance reservation created in PH-044.

payload_schema.auth_id: string (UUID v4) — FK to CardAuthorisation (ENT-032), correlation key
payload_schema.card_number_token: string — format-preserving token. NEVER the raw PAN.
payload_schema.settlement_amount: string (decimal as string) — final settled amount in GBP
payload_schema.interchange_fee: string (decimal as string) — issuer interchange income
payload_schema.net_amount: string (decimal as string) — settlement_amount minus scheme_fee

events.pci_compliance_note: card_number_token is the sole card identifier. No raw PAN. Consumers of this event do NOT enter PCI CDE scope.

consumers.action: Debit card final ledger posting: if card_type = debit, SVC-001 consumes EVT-067 and posts the final debit of settlement_amount to Account.ledger_balance. Releases the balance reservation created on receipt of EVT-065. Updates Account.available_balance to reflect the difference between the reservation (billing_amount_gbp from EVT-065) and the final settlement_amount. Idempotent on settlement_id.

Credit card final ledger posting: if card_type = credit, SVC-003 consumes EVT-067 and posts the final debit of settlement_amount to CreditCardAccount statement balance. Releases the balance reservation created on receipt of EVT-065. Updates CreditCardAccount.statement_balance incrementally. Idempotent on settlement_id.
WORM audit record for settlement. PCI DSS Req 10.2 and Visa/Mastercard settlement record retention requirements. Records interchange_fee for PSR interchange cap compliance monitoring.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-card strict ordering via card_number_token partition key on topic card.settlements.
events.worm_rationale: FCA BCOBS — account transaction records retained 7 years. PCI DSS v4.0 Req 10.7. Visa/Mastercard settlement records required for dispute resolution and chargeback processing (up to 120-day window). interchange_fee records required for PSR interchange cap compliance evidence.

events.name: SuspiciousCardActivityDetected
events.source_entity_name: Stateless — published by SVC-013 fraud pattern analysis engine
events.trigger: SVC-013 has consumed CardAuthorisationCompleted (EVT-065) or CardAuthorisationDeclined (EVT-066) and, during post-auth pattern analysis, has identified suspicious activity patterns that were not detectable from a single authorisation in real-time. Typical triggers: geographic impossibility (same card used in two countries within an impossible time window), abnormal velocity (card used at >10 merchants within 5 minutes), card testing pattern (multiple low-value declines followed by approval), or authorisation amount anomaly versus customer profile.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-004 (SVC-013); consumed by CAP-003 (SVC-011 — to trigger card block if warranted), SVC-103 (audit), and optionally by SVC-053 (Notification Service — cardholder alert). Crosses CAP-004 → CAP-003 boundary.

payload_schema.suspicious_activity_id: string (UUID v4) — unique identifier for this suspicious activity detection event
payload_schema.card_number_token: string — format-preserving token. NEVER the raw PAN.
payload_schema.triggering_auth_id: string (UUID v4) — auth_id of the CardAuthorisation event that triggered this pattern detection
payload_schema.pattern_type: string enum (geographic_impossibility | high_velocity | card_testing | amount_anomaly | mcc_anomaly | cumulative_fraud_signal)
payload_schema.risk_score: decimal (0.0–1.0) — 0 = minimal risk, 1 = maximum risk. Access-controlled: raw score shared only with SVC-011 and PER-054 (Fraud Analyst). SVC-103 receives a redacted version.
payload_schema.recommended_action: string enum (block_card | refer_to_analyst | notify_customer | monitor_only) — SVC-011 uses this field to determine whether to immediately block the card in the local card status cache
payload_schema.affected_transactions: array<string (UUID v4)> — auth_ids of recent CardAuthorisation records contributing to the pattern (last 10 max)
payload_schema.model_version: string — ML model version used for pattern detection

events.pci_compliance_note: card_number_token is the sole card identifier. No raw PAN.

consumers.action: If recommended_action = block_card: SVC-011 immediately updates the local card status cache entry for card_number_token to status = suspended_fraud_investigation. This will cause all subsequent authorisation requests for this card to be declined until the Fraud Analyst (PER-054) reviews and resolves the case. If recommended_action = refer_to_analyst or notify_customer: SVC-011 flags the card for enhanced monitoring without immediate block.

If recommended_action includes customer notification: SVC-053 dispatches a fraud alert notification to the cardholder (PER-001) via push notification (CH-002) and email. Message: 'We have detected unusual activity on your card ending [last 4 digits of card_number_token]. Your card has been temporarily blocked for your security. Please contact us if you need assistance.' The notification does NOT disclose the specific fraud pattern or risk score.

WORM audit record. Records pattern_type and recommended_action. risk_score is REDACTED from the SVC-103 general audit log — only stored in SVC-013's internal model audit store and accessible to PER-054 (Fraud Analyst) via the Fraud Operations Platform.

events.access_control_note: risk_score must NEVER be surfaced to PER-001 under any circumstances. pattern_type must NOT be disclosed to PER-001 to prevent fraud evasion. Cardholder notification uses only generic 'unusual activity' language.
events.fraud_case_creation_note: SVC-013 creates a FraudCase (ENT-F001) internally on publishing this event, consistent with the pattern established in JRN-005. The FraudCase is assigned to PER-054 (Fraud Analyst) for investigation via the Fraud Operations Platform (INTL-003).
events.ordering_guarantees: Per-card strict ordering via card_number_token partition key on topic fraud.card-alerts.
events.worm_rationale: Suspicious activity detection events are part of the fraud investigation audit trail. Required for PSR PS23/3 APP fraud claims (if the suspicious activity precedes a reported fraud). PCI DSS Req 10.2. Retained 7 years.
governance_references: GOV-004-R01 (model risk — fraud ML model SS1/23)
